name: Arcade Moderne
summary: A broad mosque is built from nested arches and symmetrical stepped minarets.
why: Both towers use the same 2/4/6-unit step sequence and terminate on y=73. The dome, recessed arch and doorway share x=54. The arch channels stop above the façade so the entire building remains one connected structure.
risk: The small tower steps simplify at 24px; the broad arch and paired verticals remain clear.
sub1: One arch sits inside another with a wide open channel
sub2: Twin minarets rise from the same foundation
reasonToChoose: A bold architectural identity with the symmetry and rhythm of Art Deco.
